purpose: Apply the B05 proposed bounded per-wave task_mcp prefix allowlist patch to core.check_runner_topic_allowlist / core.RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST scope, additively, with existing 11 static (runner, topic) pairs and the codex wildcard byte-identical before/after, write gate still off, and process launch still disabled.

applied_patch.diff_summary: After the existing RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST.get((runner, topic)) lookup returns None, look up PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST.get(topic); if the rule exists and runner.startswith(rule['runner_prefix']), return allowed=True/reason=per_wave_prefix_allowlisted when action is in rule['actions'], else allowed=False/reason=per_wave_action_not_allowed:<action>. If the prefix rule does not apply, fall through unchanged to allowed=False/reason=unknown_runner_topic_pair.

regression_static_pairs_measured.note: For every one of the 11 pre-existing (runner, topic) tuples, all 4 of its allowed actions still return {allowed: True, reason: 'allowlisted'} and the excluded 'done' action still returns {allowed: False, reason: 'action_not_allowed_for_runner_topic:done'} -- byte-identical to pre-patch behavior recorded in runner_topic_allowlist_dryrun_b05_v1.json.

new_behavior_measured.note: prefix must match exactly, no wildcard escape
malformed-token check still runs before the new prefix path is ever reached
per-wave rule is scoped to topic=='task_mcp' only; a task_mcp-prefixed runner gets no access under any other topic

write_gate_status_measured.note: Default-off write gate unchanged; this patch only widens the allowlist decision function, never touches writes_allowed() or WRITE_COMMANDS.

launch_status_measured.note: process_launch stays false; this patch does not touch cli_adapter_dryrun.py.

neural_bridge_note.doctrine: neural-control-first: this allowlist remains a deterministic safety/support-boundary gate per CLAUDE.md's explicit carve-out ('Controller/verifier layers are valid when they are moral, safety, support-boundary, rollback, or correctness checks'). No regex/keyword cognition path for task-type or route SELECTION was introduced; only a bounded runner-name-prefix check on an already-static safety boundary.

rollback.action: git revert the PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST constant + the added branch inside check_runner_topic_allowlist in core.py (single commit); RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST, CODEX_RUNNER/CODEX_ALLOWED_ACTIONS, and every other function are untouched, so rollback is a pure code revert with zero data migration and zero registry changes.
trigger_conditions: any existing static pair's {allowed, reason} changes
any topic other than task_mcp gains unintended access
malformed-token rejection stops running before the prefix check
'start' or 'done' becomes allowed for a task_mcp-prefixed runner
